shots.name: models
shots.prepare: (async()=>{const vis=e=>e.offsetParent!==null;const wait=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const btn=re=>[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].filter(vis).find(x=>re.test(x.textContent.trim()));if(btn(/^Models$/))btn(/^Models$/).click();await wait(700);const rows=[...document.querySelectorAll('div')].filter(e=>vis(e)&&e.className.includes('cursor-pointer')&&e.textContent.trim().startsWith('qwen2.5-coder:3b'));rows.sort((a,b)=>a.textContent.length-b.textContent.length);if(rows[0])rows[0].click();await wait(800);const load=btn(/^Load$/);if(load)load.click();await wait(7000);return JSON.stringify({zaladowany:!document.body.innerText.includes('Nothing is loaded right now'),karta:document.body.innerText.includes('GPU 100%')});})()

shots.name: test-run
shots.prepare: (async()=>{const vis=e=>e.offsetParent!==null;const wait=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const btn=re=>[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].filter(vis).find(x=>re.test(x.textContent.trim()));if(btn(/^Test$/))btn(/^Test$/).click();await wait(900);if(btn(/^None$/))btn(/^None$/).click();await wait(700);const t=[...document.querySelectorAll('table')].filter(vis)[0];const nag=[...t.rows[0].cells].map(c=>c.innerText.trim().split('\n')[0]);const w=[...t.rows].slice(1);const zazn=(p,k)=>{const r=w.find(x=>x.cells[0].innerText.trim().startsWith(p));if(!r)return false;const pola=[...r.querySelectorAll('input')];const i=nag.indexOf(k)-1;if(pola[i]&&!pola[i].checked)pola[i].click();return true;};zazn('qwen2.5-coder:3b','Coding');await wait(400);zazn('moondream','Images (VLM)');await wait(600);if(btn(/^Start test$/))btn(/^Start test$/).click();let cz=0,zaczeto=false,poprzednia=document.body.innerText.length;while(cz<60000&&!zaczeto){await wait(2000);cz+=2000;const teraz=document.body.innerText.length;if(teraz-poprzednia>40)zaczeto=true;poprzednia=teraz;}await wait(1500);return JSON.stringify({zaznaczone:(document.body.innerText.match(/Selected runs: \d+/)||[null])[0],trwa:!btn(/^Stop/)?false:true,rosnie:zaczeto,czekanoSek:cz/1000,postep:(document.body.innerText.match(/prompt \d+ of \d+/)||[null])[0]});})()

shots.name: model-search
shots.prepare: (async()=>{const vis=e=>e.offsetParent!==null;const wait=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const btn=re=>[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].filter(vis).find(x=>re.test(x.textContent.trim()));if(btn(/^Model search$/))btn(/^Model search$/).click();await wait(700);const input=[...document.querySelectorAll('input')].filter(vis).find(i=>i.placeholder.includes('Search repositories'));if(input){const setter=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set;setter.call(input,'qwen2.5-coder');input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));await wait(400);if(btn(/^Search$/))btn(/^Search$/).click();}let cz=0;while((document.body.innerText.match(/variants/g)||[]).length<5&&cz<30000){await wait(1500);cz+=1500;}return JSON.stringify({wierszy:(document.body.innerText.match(/variants/g)||[]).length,czekanoSek:cz/1000});})()

shots.name: classification
shots.prepare: (async()=>{const vis=e=>e.offsetParent!==null;const wait=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const btn=re=>[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].filter(vis).find(x=>re.test(x.textContent.trim()));if(btn(/^Models$/))btn(/^Models$/).click();await wait(700);const rows=[...document.querySelectorAll('div')].filter(e=>vis(e)&&e.className.includes('cursor-pointer')&&e.textContent.trim().startsWith('qwen2.5-coder:3b'));rows.sort((a,b)=>a.textContent.length-b.textContent.length);if(rows[0])rows[0].click();await wait(700);const pigulka=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].filter(vis).find(b=>b.textContent.trim()==='Response classification'&&b.className.includes('chip-off'));if(pigulka)pigulka.click();await wait(800);if(btn(/^Test$/))btn(/^Test$/).click();await wait(900);if(btn(/^None$/))btn(/^None$/).click();await wait(700);const t=[...document.querySelectorAll('table')].filter(vis)[0];const nag=[...t.rows[0].cells].map(c=>c.innerText.trim().split('\n')[0]);const r=[...t.rows].slice(1).find(x=>x.cells[0].innerText.trim().startsWith('qwen2.5-coder:3b'));const pola=[...r.querySelectorAll('input')];const i=nag.indexOf('Response classification')-1;if(pola[i]&&!pola[i].checked)pola[i].click();await wait(700);if(btn(/^Start test$/))btn(/^Start test$/).click();let cz=0;const modal=()=>!!document.querySelector('.fixed.inset-0');while(!modal()&&cz<90000){await wait(2000);cz+=2000;}await wait(1200);return JSON.stringify({modalOtwarty:modal(),zaznaczone:(document.body.innerText.match(/Selected runs: \d+/)||[null])[0],czekanoSek:cz/1000});})()
